title: gemini-watermark reference manifest
description: Decision- and score-level oracle for the TypeScript port, produced by tools/reference/gen_golden.py from the pinned gwt-mini v0.3.2 binary. Scores parsed directly from the -v log carry exactly 3 decimal places. The one exception is a circuit-breaker detection's confidence, which the log never prints: it is reconstructed as round(spatial*0.5, 4), with error against the binary's internal float bounded by 3e-4 (see docs/plan/DEVIATIONS.md D2). Compare all scores with the 2e-3 budget from PLAN.md, never with toBeCloseTo. Decisions, geometry and exit codes are exact.

reference_binary.description: Human-readable identification of the binary; the machine-checkable identity lives in toolchain.

toolchain.description: Identity of everything that shaped the data. Any change here invalidates the oracle.

upstream_commit.description: Full HEAD sha of the upstream C++ checkout, measured (the pin is a prefix).

score.description: TM_CCOEFF_NORMED correlation or a value derived from one; negative values are normal on clean images.

detection.description: One detect_one_variant() invocation, in log order. A default run records the V2 gate attempt, then (on the V2->V1 fallback) the V1 gate attempt, and after a passing gate the re-detection remove_watermark() performs internally for the position snap.

circuit_breaker.description: True when spatial < 0.25 rejected the image before the gradient/variance stages ran. The breaker log line prints only spatial, so confidence here is reconstructed as round(spatial*0.5, 4) rather than read from the binary; upstream does not clamp it, so it can be negative.

detected.description: The internal 0.35 label. Informational only -- the CLI gate is the separate detection threshold (default 0.25).

run.description: One invocation of the reference binary.

argv.description: Arguments after the binary path, with <in>/<out> placeholders -- the manifest is committed and must carry no machine-local paths.

exit_code.description: cli_app.cpp run(): 0 processed, 1 single-file skip, 2 real failure.

removal_position.description: Parsed from the 'Removing watermark at (x, y)' debug line: the post-snap position actually removed at.

alpha_map.description: Template size actually used. On forced_size runs this deliberately disagrees with fixture.logo_size -- that is the upstream quirk, recorded as-is.

output_decoded_sha256.description: SHA256 over decoded RGB pixels (cv2 IMREAD_COLOR, BGR->RGB, contiguous uint8 HxWx3), not container bytes -- immune to PNG encoder drift (docs/plan/DEVIATIONS.md). Null when no output was written.

decoded_pixel_sha256.description: Identity of the pixels the port must consume. For the jpg case this is the cv2 decode, which is what the reference binary sees -- the TS side never decodes JPEG.

oneOf.description: Negatives: clean images with no watermark.

eligible_for.description: Which downstream suites consume this case. Derived from measured run results by gen_golden.py, never hand-assigned; the suites assert executed == eligible - explicitly-skipped.
